## Duke Symphony Orchestra 100th Anniversary Gala

The DSO is celebrating its 100th anniversary with an all-Mendelssohn program. Let's kick it with Felix!

- Saturday October 3 at 7:30 pm;
- Baldwin Auditorium (East Campus);
- [@dukesymphony](https://www.instagram.com/dukesymphony/).
